name: spoilarr
short: TMDb API integration for movie/TV information
description: Provides tools for searching movies/TV shows and retrieving details, cast, and crew information from The Movie Database (TMDb). Supports spoiler censoring mode.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Spoilarr! Configure your TMDb API key with `[p]spoilarr apikey <key>`. Get your API key at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api
author: nntin
